overview_description.description:
Avito is a classified advertisements platform that allows users to buy and sell used cars, clothes, real estate, and other accessories. The Buyers and sellers use its line of business for the exchange of products and services such as coins, collectibles, computers, memorabilia, stamps, and toys, as well as concert and sporting tickets. 

Jonas Nordlanderr and Filip Engelbert founded Avito in 2007. Its headquarters is in Moscow in the Russian Federation.
